title: Evaluating Language Model Features for Zero-Shot Time-Series Anomaly Detection Under Isolation Assumption
abstract: arXiv:2611.07720v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Time-Series Anomaly Detection (TSAD) is a fundamentally challenging task: it is unsupervised, requires high local precision capabilities, and suffers from limited labelled data. Recent work has explored adapting Large Language Models (LLMs) to time-series via cross-modal transfer. However, existing approaches are poorly suited to Multivariate TSAD (MTSAD), as tokenisation often obscures fine-grained temporal and variables structures, and most methods optimise auxiliary objectives such as forecasting or reconstruction. We posit that these surrogate objectives become unreliable as model capacity increases. Highly expressive models risk reconstructing or forecasting anomalies, undermining the foundations of both strategies. Instead, we propose to use LLMs purely as feature extractors and directly analyse their induced feature spaces. In this work, investigate the ability of LLMs to provide useful representations for MTSADs in a zero-shot

translated_title: 在隔离假设下评估语言模型特征用于零样本时间序列异常检测
translated_abstract: 时间序列异常检测（TSAD）是一项具有根本性挑战的任务：它是无监督的，需要高局部精度能力，且受限于有限的标注数据。近期研究探索了通过跨模态迁移将大语言模型（LLM）适配到时间序列领域。然而，现有方法并不适合多变量时间序列异常检测（MTSAD），因为分词处理往往会掩盖细粒度的时间结构和变量结构，且大多数方法都在优化诸如预测或重建等辅助目标。我们认为，随着模型容量的增加，这些替代目标会变得不可靠——高表达能力的模型可能会重建或预测出异常，从而破坏这两种策略的基础。相反，我们提出将LLM纯粹用作特征提取器，并直接分析其诱导的特征空间。在本工作中，我们研究了LLM在零样本设置下为MTSAD提供有用表示的能力。
tldr: 该论文提出将大语言模型纯粹作为特征提取器用于零样本多变量时间序列异常检测，通过直接分析其诱导的特征空间，规避了预测或重建等辅助目标在模型容量增大时会重建异常而变得不可靠的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes using LLMs purely as feature extractors for zero-shot multivariate time-series anomaly detection, directly analyzing their induced feature spaces to avoid the unreliability of surrogate objectives like forecasting or reconstruction, which risk reconstructing anomalies as model capacity increases.
